evals.prompt: ik heb een nieuwe playlist gemaakt op Spotify die 'Coffee Shop' heet — voeg toe aan mijn config
evals.expected_output: Skill picks sub-flow C (extend). Runs list-playlists --all to discover the Coffee Shop ID, surfaces the untracked entry, confirms via AskUserQuestion before editing playlists.json, and verifies with a follow-up list-playlists.
expectations: Skill identifies this as sub-flow C (extend) — playlists.json already exists
Skill plans to run '.venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py list-playlists --all' from the repo root
Skill uses AskUserQuestion to confirm the playlists.json edit before writing
Skill preserves the existing key order in playlists.json (append, do not reorder)
Skill plans a verification step ('.venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py list-playlists' after the edit)

evals.prompt: set up mijn config — ik heb nog geen playlists.json
evals.expected_output: Skill picks sub-flow B (bootstrap). Runs list-playlists --all, seeds from playlists.example.json, walks the user through picking targets + optional aliases/categories/catch_all, asks before writing.
expectations: Skill identifies this as sub-flow B (bootstrap) — no playlists.json exists yet
Skill references playlists.example.json as the schema seed, not as the literal output
Skill walks the user through optional sections (aliases, categories, special_rules, catch_all)
Skill uses AskUserQuestion before creating the file
Skill omits empty optional sections rather than emitting empty objects

evals.prompt: welke playlists ken ik in mijn config?
evals.expected_output: Skill picks sub-flow A (inspect). Runs list-playlists (no --all) and surfaces the output verbatim. No Spotify API call, no edit.
expectations: Skill identifies this as sub-flow A (inspect) — purely informational
Skill runs '.venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py list-playlists' WITHOUT --all
Skill does NOT make a Spotify API call
Skill does NOT propose any edit to playlists.json
Skill surfaces the CLI output verbatim (or summarises it in Dutch)

evals.prompt: voeg 'dnb' toe als alias voor mijn Drum & Bass playlist
evals.expected_output: Alias-only edit. Skill validates that 'Drum & Bass' is a key under 'playlists', then proposes adding `"dnb": "Drum & Bass"` to the aliases block. No Spotify API call needed.
expectations: Skill validates that 'Drum & Bass' is an existing key in playlists.json before proposing the alias
Skill does NOT run list-playlists --all (no new Spotify ID needed)
Skill renders the planned diff showing the new alias entry
Skill confirms via AskUserQuestion before writing
Skill warns if the target key doesn't exist instead of writing a broken alias

evals.prompt: voeg dit nummer toe aan mijn House playlist: https://open.spotify.com/track/1W5mUuAOQSSKUbLOt7cDhq
evals.expected_output: Not in scope for playlist-config — this is a track-add operation. Skill routes to playlist-match or the 'add' CLI command instead of editing playlists.json.
expectations: Skill does NOT propose editing playlists.json
Skill does NOT run list-playlists
Skill routes the user to playlist-match (for classification + add) or the 'add' CLI command directly
Skill explains that playlist-config manages the registry, not track contents
